name: – After § 4 – Am 11
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Council’s recommendation on smoke- and aerosol-free environments
part_text: 4a. Reiterates its conclusion that e-cigarettes could allow some smokers to progressively quit smoking; considers, at the same time, that e-cigarettes should not be attractive to young people and non-smokers; believes that the updated Council recommendation and national provisions should take this perspective into account;
